Main is shehar ki qasam khaata hoon
Aur tum isi shehar mein to rehte ho
Aur tumhaare baap Aadam alaihis-salaam aur un ki aulaad ki qasam
Hum ne insaan ko mashaqqat mein rehne waala banaaya hai
Kya us ka khayaal yeh hai ke us par koi qaabu na pa sakega
Ke woh kehta hai ke main ne be-tahaasha sarf kiya hai
Kya us ka khayaal hai ke us ko kisi ne nahin dekha hai
Kya hum ne us ke liye do aankhein nahin qaraar di hain
Aur zabaan aur do hont bhi
Aur hum ne use dono raaston ki hidaayat di hai
Phir woh ghaati par se kyon nahin guzra
Aur tum kya jaano yeh ghaati kya hai
Kisi gardan ka aazaad karaana
Ya bhook ke din mein khaana khilaana
Kisi qaraabat-daar yateem ko
Ya khaaksaar miskeen ko
Phir woh un logon mein shaamil ho jaata jo imaan laaye aur unhon ne sabr aur marhamat ki ek doosre ko naseehat ki
Yahi log khush-naseebi waale hain
Aur jin logon ne hamaari aayaat se inkaar kiya hai woh bad-bakhti waale hain
Inhein aag mein daal kar use har taraf se band kar diya jaaega
